notes.notes:
It's time to sell your newly refurbished Fitness Center! During this time, you will earn a specific amount that you will be able to spend on business development and the purchase of other damaged premises.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After the renovation, it’s time to decorate the interior. This is definitely one of the most enjoyable activities because you have a free hand when it comes to the appearance of the permisses. In today’s devlog, we will also discuss factors influencing the attractiveness of your Fitness Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746592/889f12aa127e0cf8df791edfb88640666e2864ca.gif[/img]

Decorating involves equipping a gym with training devices in such a way as to attract specific groups of customers and provide them with a comfortable place to exercise. The better you follow these tips, the more money you get. Every gym center has a minimum number of specific hardware that must be included (for example, two treadmills, three bathrooms, etc.). To increase Fitness Center attractiveness, you should do much more than the minimum required. Additionally, various attractions affect the number of acquired customers. And don’t forget about the limited budget to start.

In the next devlog, we will develop a topic of the selling system. We encourage you to visit Fitness Center Renovator Discord and other social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/MfzDVGZZzp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746592/a5466193b9a7e3bdc756337eeeb25ca9aacff7a6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Welcome!

In today’s devlog, we will talk about renovating a ruined facility and how to prepare for it. Of course, renovation, after purchasing a building, is always the first stage of work. Before decorating this place, you need to prepare it properly to meet people’s expectations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746592/a1886277ec97566394b702a18d8d5cd222f3eef1.gif[/img]

Be prepared for the fact that abandoned gyms will be in terrible condition. Renovation work includes demolition or wall cleaning, pest elimination, vacuuming, floor replacement, fungus removal, etc. But for this type of task, you will need the right tools. Always have supplies ready before starting work. Depending on the number of finished orders and their quality, you will receive adequate payment. Earn and invest in the development of your business. Thanks to a better supply and experience, your gyms will attract more customers from all over the area. Develop and grow stronger!

How do you like the presented solution? Would you like to change or add something? Share your opinion with us on our Discord or in the comments section. We also encourage you to visit our other social media!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

An essential element of the game after a successful renovation is the attractiveness of the premises. The greater the attractiveness, the more you will earn from selling the modernized gym. What are the most critical factors influencing the splendor of your Fitness Center? In today’s devlog, we will talk a bit about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746592/8c0dd529aa280fc0e419687184d7d74f39ec3d70.png[/img]

The type of exercise available is a significant element. The more types of workouts the gym offers the more customers (and potential profit) it will eventually attract. Examples of the types of training that we can mention are: CrossFit, Endurance training, Strengthening training, Gymnastic training, Dance training, and Combat training. Don’t forget that for greater comfort, these categories can be divided into the men’s section, women’s section, and co-educational section. 

The functionality will be another factor. The key is taking care of new customers and keeping the regulars. Therefore they must have enough equipment to avoid queues and plenty of space to feel better during the exercise. The exercise gear should be of the best quality. 

The third part will be an attraction. You will be able to equip your Fitness Center with optional prestige-increasing extras. We are talking about large mirrors, shops with supplements, vending machines, showers, or personal areas.

That’s all for today. If you are interested in these topics, visit our Discord and check the rest of our social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/CYpGd77GaF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746592/f110c6dc3821a80911692730a8b626eda6a8c55b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hello, Gamers!

Welcome to the first Fitness Center Renovator devlog! We want to bring you closer to the content related to our game. We hope to diversify your waiting time for the premiere with our posts.

As you guessed, in this game you will be responsible for renovating the fitness center. You start out by purchasing an old and dilapidated facility that once housed a gym. Your task is to renovate the entire facility, bring it to a satisfactory condition so that every customer who comes to exercise will be satisfied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746592/6a141052ad0978e77ef631dfc3d69e747b048cd9.png[/img]

At the entrance don’t forget about the reception desk. It would be good if the counter was aesthetically lit with your company displayed logo above it. This place should attract potential customers.

It is very important to plan each room and set up exercise equipment. Everyone must have access to the dumbbells, chin-up bars, treadmills, exercise benches, and definitely an exercise atlas. As you develop, you will be able to buy newer and better equipment.

Every person after intense exercise will want to wash. Plan the arrangement of bathrooms for women and men section. It is crucial to take the place hygienic. Customers are the most important!

Thank you for your attention, we invite you to check our Discord and other social media. If you have any ideas for the next devlogs, feel free.
